DOBLE Executive Secretary and Chief of Staff/Liga Secretariat Liga ng mga Barangay-Lapu-Lapu City Chapter InbIapuIapucity2023@gmaiI.com Dear Mr. Dobie: This refers to your earlier e-mail requesting for this Department's Opinion on a matter concerning the issuance of an Official Receipt (OR) of the Liga ng mga Barangay Lapu- Lapu City Chapter. It was stated that the Liga ng mga Barangay Lapu-Lapu City Chapter has annually collected Liga Annual Dues and other collections such as registration fees from seminars/ training, and other proceeds of events and fundraising that the chapter initiated and conducted. For this, it issued Official Receipts (ORS) for every payment and collections received. The said OR forms part of the supporting documents for the Barangays and LGUs to validate and liquidate payments made. In this regard, you would like to "request a Legal Opinion on the obtaining and issuance of an Official Receipt (OR) of the Liga ng mga Barangay Lapu-Lapu City Chapter and other Liga Local Chapters and for this Department to resolve not to register in the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) to obtain the Official Receipt (OR) as the Liga is not merely a Drivate association but a government organization" At the outset, we must state that the Department is bereft of authority to declare that local Liga Chapters need not register with SEC. For further guidance on the matter, we strongly recommend that the same be referred to SEC as it is the authority which has absolute jurisdiction, supervision, and control over all corporations, partnerships, and associations. Be that as it may, and for purposes of information and guidance only, please be appraised that associations are required to register their entities with SEC before they can conduct business activities, issue invoices and receipts and be entitled to certain rights under the country's corporate laws. Without SEC registration, associations cannot legally engage in business activities or enter into contracts. We hope to have guided you on the matter. "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

This opinion is based solely on the facts and representations you have narrated in your letter and our appreciation of the same. Further, this opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ATTY. ROMEO P.
